Name: Ponyta (horse replacer)
Author: Zhuria
Description:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BOxWppj.gif[/img]

[size=3]This mod replaces the vanilla horse with Ponyta from Pokémon. Ponyta has a new fiery mane, tail, forelock and leg flames that appear to flicker when she moves. Additionally, all my horse mods have a thinner face in the front view. This version has no saddle. Shiny Ponyta is also included and can be changed in your config or Generic Mod Config Menu (if you have it installed).[/size][size=3]
[/size]
[u][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[*][size=3](optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ for easy config setting management[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]
[/list][size=3]
This is my original Ponyta from way back in 2016, now officially converted to work with Content Patcher and Stardew Valley 1.6. Enjoy![/size]
[size=1][color=#999999](now with 100% less XNB!)[/color]

[/size][size=3]Should you encounter any issues please feel free to comment or message me on Discord - my username is sepzero[/size]
